answer: Bind each identity to its own hardware. To register, an agent presents an attestation from a secure enclave chip, signed by the chipmaker, and the network records that chip's key so it can back only one account. A thousand clones then means buying a thousand chips, not typing a thousand names. Like pigment pressed into wet plaster, the binding can't be wiped off and reused. Duplicate chip keys get flagged together, while honest agents graze the reward meadow freely, each a single ember burning on its own fuel.
